value.description: Controlled value: { text, mentions }. Each mention has kind, id, label, start, and end offsets into text.

defaultValue.description: Initial value when uncontrolled. Defaults to empty text and no mentions.

onChange.description: Called on every edit with the new text and the mentions moved or dropped to match it.

people.description: People offered after @. Each has id, name, and optional role and avatar. Leave it out to turn person mentions off.

channels.description: Channels offered after #. Each has id, name, and optional description and members count. Leave it out to turn channel mentions off.

onMentionAdd.description: Called when a suggestion is chosen and becomes a mention.

onSubmit.description: Called on Enter when submitOnEnter is set and the text is not blank.

submitOnEnter.description: Enter submits and Shift+Enter adds a line. Enter during IME composition never submits.

placeholder.description: Placeholder text for the empty field.

maxRows.description: The field grows to this many rows, then scrolls.

placement.description: Where suggestions open. auto flips above the caret when there is less than 300px below it and more room above.

maxSuggestions.description: Most suggestions shown at once, best matches first.

disabled.description: Disables the textarea and dims the field.

name.description: Forwarded to the textarea. The form value is the plain text; use serializeMentions to keep ids.

id.description: Forwarded to the textarea, for an external label.
